pages.title: 两类治疗目标与个体化管理
不同研究间效应一致与效应差异的两种方法学情形
有结构/生理异常而无气流阻塞与给定临床背景下的确诊条件

sol.方案: 两类治疗目标形成等权分叉分组；两幅抽象情境构成主体：当下症状负担与未来风险防护。原句按起句/左目标/右目标拆一次；个体化说明横跨底部。

visual_parts.左情境：抽象人物周围松散压力带: 缓解和减轻症状的影响；不代表量化疗效
visual_parts.右情境：保护性弧面面对远处抽象事件形块: 降低未来可能不良健康事件的风险；不代表风险归零
visual_parts.底部整宽说明区: 全球临床环境适用与匹配患者需求

sol.forbidden_implications: 不画前后状态比较、量值、两目标先后流程、药物、风险归零或治疗到疗效因果箭头。
sol.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE complete 16:9 Chinese undergraduate teaching slide. This experiment must use substantial explanatory diagram geometry as the main visual, not decorative icons, not a campus/book illustration. The common reference image supplies ivory #F8F6EE, forest-green #183A29/#355A42, sage, quiet academic typography only. No copied reference wording. Main substantive title is biggest; 前言与方法学 if present is small navigation eyebrow. Readable Chinese sans body, restrained academic title. No botanical/book/campus decoration.
EXPLANATORY COMPOSITION: Main explanatory graphic is a large two-way grouping bracket with NO arrowheads, starting with the exact opening clause. Below it TWO equal visual narrative scenes occupy most of page, not merely icons atop cards. Left: an abstract human figure inside spacious loosened layered pressure ribbons as a metaphor for symptom burden easing, no before/after pair. Right: a protective curved screen facing soft distant irregular event forms on a pale horizon as metaphor for possible future adverse-event risk, screen not sealed and events not eradicated. Both equal green/sage treatment. Their exact clause text sits integrated under its scene; do not duplicate any sentence. Bottom full width applicability statement.
VISUAL MEANINGS: {"无箭头分叉括号": "治疗目标分为两类", "左情境：抽象人物周围松散压力带": "缓解和减轻症状的影响；不代表量化疗效", "右情境：保护性弧面面对远处抽象事件形块": "降低未来可能不良健康事件的风险；不代表风险归零", "底部整宽说明区": "全球临床环境适用与匹配患者需求"}
FORBIDDEN IMPLICATIONS: 不画前后状态比较、量值、两目标先后流程、药物、风险归零或治疗到疗效因果箭头。
EXACT TEXT SEGMENTS: render each exactly ONCE, in order within each original sentence, line wrapping freely. Do NOT print a full sentence and then repeat its clauses; only these segments. No new headings or medical labels.
[
  "前言与方法学",
  "治疗目标与个体化管理",
  "治疗目标分为两类：",
  "一类旨在缓解和减轻症状的影响，",
  "另一类则降低未来可能对患者造成不良健康事件的风险（例如急性加重）。",
  "这种管理方法适用于全球任何临床环境，并将慢性阻塞性肺疾病治疗推向个体化医疗——使患者的治疗更紧密地匹配其需求。",
  "来源：00_前言和方法学 第1页",
  "02"
]
The only extra text allowed is the small nature marker: 概念示意，非研究数据. Sources and original page number at bottom, clearly legible. All qualifiers, negatives, operators and numerals preserved. A concept drawing is not medical approval.

luna.prompt:
Create a complete, legible 16:9 Chinese undergraduate medical teaching slide, 1280x720. Follow the attached shared template reference: warm ivory paper, muted deep forest green, restrained sage, generous whitespace, clear academic typography. The explanatory diagram is the visual subject; the main content title is prominent and larger than chapter navigation. Use drawn forms that explain the stated classification, comparison, or condition; decoration is secondary. Reproduce every locked string below exactly once, in reading order, including punctuation, negation, qualifiers and symbols. Each clause must appear in exactly one place in the slide. Do not duplicate a clause or show a full sentence together with fragments. Do not add words, abbreviations, headings, captions or labels beyond the locked text. Preserve source and page marker.
CONCEPT: 两类治疗目标与个体化管理
GRAPHIC PARTS AND SOURCE MEANING:
- Use the opening clause of the locked body as a small lead above two equal goal areas.
- Put the first goal clause only in the left area and the second goal clause only in the right area. Pair the left with a calm, open breathing-space illustration and the right with an unnumbered horizon marker enclosed by a boundary. These are abstract illustrations, not outcomes or data. Keep the two goals equal; no arrow between them.
- Use the global-scope clause once as the enclosing frame for both goals and the management-fit region.
- Place the individualization clause once in the lower band. Use interlocking alignment shapes to show the explicitly stated fit between treatment and needs, with no extra text.
PROHIBITED IMPLICATIONS:
不画两类目标先后步骤、治疗效果数值、因果箭头或新增疗法；不画药物、器械、解剖或明确临床结局；不让图标替代目标关系；不重复主句或分句；不添加非锁定标签。
LOCKED TEXT, each string once:
“前言与方法学”
“治疗目标与个体化管理”
“治疗目标分为两类：一类旨在缓解和减轻症状的影响，另一类则降低未来可能对患者造成不良健康事件的风险（例如急性加重）。”
“这种管理方法适用于全球任何临床环境，并将慢性阻塞性肺疾病治疗推向个体化医疗——使患者的治疗更紧密地匹配其需求。”
“来源：00_前言和方法学 第1页”
“02”

interpretation: “治疗目标分为两类：”作为两分支起点。
左分支“一类旨在缓解和减轻症状的影响，”对应开放气流和舒展空间的抽象场景；右分支“另一类则降低未来可能对患者造成不良健康事件的风险（例如急性加重）。”对应未标刻度的远景事件标记和包围边界。两区等权，不用箭头连接两类目标。
“这种管理方法适用于全球任何临床环境，”作为覆盖目标区与个体化区的范围外框。
底部将“并将慢性阻塞性肺疾病治疗推向个体化医疗——”与“使患者的治疗更紧密地匹配其需求。”以对齐嵌合形状表达原句明示的匹配。

“09”
